edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The Buyer shall pay the Seller USD [●] for the Shares (the “Purchase Price”), in full at Closing by wire transfer of immediately available funds to the account designated by the Seller in writing at least three Business Days before Closing. The Purchase Price remains subject to agreement.
edits.name: Purchase price and payment

edits.text: 2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur within thirty days of signing on a mutually agreed date. The Buyer's obligation to complete Closing is not subject to obtaining financing. Before signing, the Buyer shall provide evidence reasonably satisfactory to the Seller of funds available to pay the Purchase Price in full at Closing. Such evidence shall not create a financing condition.
edits.name: Closing and funding

edits.text: 3. FINANCIAL-STATEMENT REPRESENTATION. Except as fairly disclosed in the disclosure schedule delivered before signing, with sufficient detail to identify the nature and scope of the exception, the Seller represents at signing and Closing that the Company's audited financial statements for the year ended [●] and unaudited financial statements for the period ended [●], copies of which are attached as Schedule [●], have been prepared in accordance with [agreed accounting standards], consistently applied, and fairly present in all material respects the Company's financial position and results of operations for the periods stated. The unaudited financial statements are subject to normal year-end adjustments and the absence of footnotes. To the Seller's Knowledge, the Company has no liabilities required to be reflected or reserved against under those accounting standards other than liabilities reflected or reserved against in those statements, fairly disclosed in the disclosure schedule, or incurred in the ordinary course since the latest balance-sheet date. “Seller's Knowledge” means the actual knowledge of [identified individuals] after reasonable inquiry of the personnel responsible for the relevant matters.
edits.name: Defined financial representation

edits.text: 4. INDEMNITY. Following Closing, the Seller shall indemnify the Buyer for actual losses arising from a breach of Clause 3, subject to the exceptions and qualifications expressly stated in that clause. Claims under this clause must be notified in writing within [18] months after Closing, describing in reasonable detail the factual basis and estimated amount where reasonably ascertainable; claims so notified survive until finally resolved. Liability shall arise only once aggregate qualifying losses exceed USD [●], and then only for the excess, and shall not exceed [●]% of the Purchase Price in aggregate. Recoverable losses exclude punitive damages except to the extent payable to a third party. The Buyer shall take reasonable steps to mitigate losses and shall not recover more than once for the same loss; recoveries shall be reduced by insurance proceeds or third-party recoveries actually received, net of reasonable recovery costs. These limitations do not limit liability for a party's own fraud. The bracketed claim period, basket, and cap remain subject to agreement.
edits.name: Indemnity scope and limitations

We will coordinate provision of the financial statements and proposed disclosure schedule for review; all terms remain subject to our client’s approval and execution of definitive documentation.
